fraud.text:
(a) During the course of our examination of the books and records of the Company and according to the information and explanations given to us, considering the principles of materiality outlined in Standards on Auditing, we report that no fraud by the Company or on the Company has been noticed or reported during the year.

(b) According to the information and explanations given to us, no report under sub-section (12) of Section 143 of the Act has been filed by the auditors in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under Rule 13 of the Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government.

(c) We have taken into consideration the whistle blower complaints received by the Company during the year while determining the nature, timing and extent of our audit procedures.

statutory_dues.text:

operating_notes.text: FY26 Standalone Free Cash Flow reached ₹9,200 Cr.
FY26 investment spending stood at ~₹3,000 Cr with FY27 expected in a similar range.
Freight Commerce Solutions (Freight Tiger) reported revenue from operations of ₹26.7 Cr in FY25, ₹17.8 Cr in FY24, and ₹18.9 Cr in FY23.
FY26 standalone free cash flow reached ₹9,200 Cr, translating to a year-end net cash position of ₹7,500 Cr.
May 2026 total commercial vehicle sales stood at 32,850 units (up 17% YoY), with domestic sales at 30,784 units (up 19% YoY).
Q1 wholesales were about 108,700 units, up 26% YoY, with HCV at 26.4K, ILMCV 17.1K, SCV Pickup 38.3K, CV Passenger 18.7K and exports 8.1K.
VAHAN market share in heavy commercial vehicles strengthened to 56.3%, with 100 bps sequential and 170 bps improvement versus FY26.
Around 4,500 government CV passenger orders and more than 850 electric bus orders were on hand at the end of Q1.
Total wholesales for Q2 FY27 stood at 135.1K units (+42%)
Q2 FY27 standalone wholesales at 135.1K units, up 42% YoY.
TML CV Holdings B.V. reached a shareholding of 89.42% of Iveco Group N.V.'s common share capital.
Collaborated with Amazon to deploy 3,000 electric trucks in India.
Electrifying the 2,800-km Delhi–Bengaluru–Chennai corridor along NH48.
Q2 wholesales reached 1,35,100 units, up 42% YoY.
Completed initial settlement of tender offer for Iveco Group, acquiring 89.42% stake on October 30, 2026.
October 2026 sales stood at 47,652 units (up 27% YoY), with domestic CV sales at 39,784 units (up 13% YoY) and international sales at 7,868 units (up 225% YoY).

timeline.summary: Tata Motors reported April 2026 commercial vehicle sales of 34,833 units, up 28% YoY.
2026-05-12: Tata Motors incorporated Teesta Renewable Energy Private Limited as a special purpose vehicle with 26% stake
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹26,098 Cr, net profit ₹1,793 Cr.
Tata Motors presented Q4FY26 results, expecting Iveco transaction closure by Q2FY27 and recommending a ₹4/share dividend.
Tata Motors Limited shared the Q4 FY26 earnings conference call recording link on May 13, 2026, via its website.
Tata Motors acquired an ~18% stake in Freight Tiger for ₹95.66 Cr, taking total holding up to 63.6% to make it a subsidiary.
Tata Motors reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹24,500 Cr with an EBITDA margin of 13.9% and expects Iveco transaction closure by Q2 FY27.

Tata Motors Limited’s Board recommended ₹4.00 final dividend per ₹2 equity share (200%) for FY2025-26, subject to AGM approval on June 29, 2026, with record date June 12, 2026, and payment by July 2, 2026.
Tata Motors Limited informed shareholders of tax deduction on dividend.
Tata Motors reported total commercial vehicle sales of 32,850 units in May 2026, up 17% YoY.
Tata Motors submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR) for FY25-26 with reasonable assurance from KPMG.
Tata Motors dispatched notices for its 2nd Annual General Meeting scheduled for June 29, 2026, and the Integrated Annual Report for FY26.

Tata Motors' Q1FY27 call (Aug 12, 2026) reported standalone revenue up 23% to ₹19,300 Cr on 26% volume growth, EBITDA margin down 60 bps to 11.7%, and free cash flow of ₹1,114 Cr; management guided Q2 to double-digit growth and said the 70,000-unit Indonesia order will be supplied over FY27-FY28.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹25,338 Cr (+36.3% YoY), net profit ₹1,254 Cr (against a loss of ₹867 Cr a year earlier).
Tata Motors reported Q2 FY27 standalone revenue of ₹23,930 Cr (+42% YoY) and PBT (bei) of ₹2,660 Cr (+51% YoY) alongside robust FCF of ₹4,606 Cr.
Tata Motors Limited (formerly TML Commercial Vehicles Limited) shared Q2 FY27 earnings call recording on October 23, 2026, via its website.
Tata Motors announced provisional results of its voluntary totalitarian tender offer for Iveco Group N.V., reaching an 89.42% stake.
Tata Motors collaborated with Amazon to deploy 3,000 electric trucks across India, starting with the Delhi-Bengaluru-Chennai corridor.
Tata Motors reported Q2 FY27 standalone revenue of ₹23,900 crore, up 42% YoY, driven by broad-based volume growth and the Indonesia export ramp-up.
Tata Motors allotted 41,981 equity shares under its Share-based Long Term Incentive Scheme on October 30, 2026.
Tata Motors completed the initial settlement of its tender offer for Iveco Group on October 30, 2026, acquiring an 89.42% equity stake.
Tata Motors appointed Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP as Statutory Auditors, replacing B S R & Co. LLP to align audit processes following the Iveco Group acquisition.
Tata Motors reported October 2026 total CV sales of 47,652 units, up 27% YoY driven by a 225% surge in international sales.
